    requires forall i :: 0 <= i < |x| ==> x[i] >= 0 // all integers in x are positive
    ensures forall y :: y in result ==> y in x // all elements in result are from x
    ensures result == Sorted(result) // result is sorted in increasing order
    ensures forall d :: d in result ==> NoEvenDigits(d) // all digits in result elements are odd

method NoEvenDigits(n: int) returns (b: bool)
    requires n >= 0
    ensures b ==> forall d :: d in Digits(n) ==> d % 2 != 0 // if b is true, all digits of n are odd

// Helper method to get the digits of a number
method Digits(n: int) returns (d: seq<int>)
    requires n >= 0
    ensures |d| > 0 ==> d[0] == n % 10 // the last digit is the last element in the sequence
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |d| ==> d[i] >= 0 && d[i] < 10 // all elements are valid digits
